scope: Target-independent module pass interface, per-instance execution-based translation validation and telemetry. No optimizing pass is admitted to default O2 by this package.

implementation.location: A separate evocc-passes crate using existing EvoIR and interpreter APIs, not evocc-eqopt
implementation.interface: Pass consumes a validated module, produces a staged module plus explicit eligible/taken/declined counts. Pipeline publishes only after validation succeeds for all supplied executions. An empty pipeline returns the unchanged module and canonical bytes.
implementation.class_authority: The new pass API always reports VALIDATED, never CHANGED_VERIFIED. VERIFIED is reserved for the existing independently replayed EqSat chain; LOWERING labels the existing lowering path.
implementation.observations: Reuse existing interpreter outcomes and equality projections: results, global/memory and observable events, diagnostics and bounded completion. Steps are reported separately, not required to be equal. Unsupported externals, fuel exhaustion, fenv/asm/volatile/atomic effects are explicit ineligible cases, never PASS.
implementation.telemetry: Pass name/version, class, eligible sites, taken sites, declined reason counts, before/after IR hashes, validation input count/outcomes, interpreter steps, optional estimated bytes, actual bytes only when measured, elapsed pass time separated from validation time.
implementation.driver: Opt-in --opt-pass=identity initially and JSON --pass-report path; no enabled pass preserves existing output and avoids extra execution. Driver integration coordinated with N04. Identity is a wiring test, not a size improvement.
implementation.native: Reuse existing four-lane differential runner after module passes; do not add another native harness. No native correctness claim from interpreter-only TV.

corpus.generated: Existing evocc-randgen deterministic generator, seeds 0..255 as initial RED subset, then existing 21000-program frozen gate population before any non-identity pass default admission
corpus.source_differential: Reuse existing evocc-lower day6 G3 C-HIR/EvoIR bridge and source fixtures; compare before and after modules without changing either interpreter
corpus.ladder: Integer-mix control and existing admitted deterministic ladder inputs; library external-call gaps remain explicit unsupported coverage

red_cases: Deliberately wrong pass changes a returned value; TV detects the mismatch on the generated corpus and does not publish staged output
A pass introduces an interpreter diagnostic, changes memory/event observations or creates malformed IR; reject each
No enabled pass preserves canonical module bytes and legacy driver output
Telemetry denominator differs from taken plus declined; reject the inconsistent report
Unsupported execution and exhausted fuel cannot be relabeled validated
Multiple passes validate each intermediate module rather than only accidentally equivalent final output
Native/assembly estimates are not represented as measured byte savings

resources.retention: Keep only compact counts/hashes and minimal failing source. Delete test intermediates, no new target/workspace/kernel/VM disk.

acceptance: Bad-pass injection detected, default identity preserved, steps/observations exported for N05
Focused framework/source/CLI tests and existing native differential for admitted cases
Compact receipt, one-page notebook, TODO, disk net change in bounded commit
stop_rule: Two-week box; do not change interpreter, IR semantics, registry or trust policy to accommodate a pass. Unmodeled cases constrain admission instead of silently passing.
claim_ceiling: Execution-based validation on named inputs, not a universal equivalence proof, whole-program coverage or certified EqSat optimization.
